content.comment_body: Hello, I'm experiencing an issue with [product_name] [version_no] running on Windows Vista. When using XP compatibility mode and attempting to save a project, the PC locks up and I have to force close the application with ctrl+alt+del. Communication with [product_name] works fine, including uploads and downloads, but saving locally causes crashes. The same problem occurs with [product_name] [version_no] on Vista. Any advice is appreciated. [user_name]
Check your Java version—it should be a 6u17 release. Also, confirm that you’re not using 64-bit Vista. You need admin privileges and should ensure the program is executed as administrator.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report severe freezing and crashes when saving in [product_name] [version_no] on Windows Vista, both directly and using XP compatibility mode. Uploading and downloading to [product_name] hardware works normally, but saving on the computer leads to instability. The discussion highlights concerns about Java version compatibility and the need for administrative rights, pointing to issues with system permissions and software requirements.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to save their projects within [product_name] [version_no] on Windows Vista without experiencing system freezing or crashes, similar to the reliable function they observe when uploading or downloading to hardware.
